description: A four-channel VCA expander for SYNC3XL, which goes immediately to the right of it and sets the level of its three oscillator outputs and its mix output

params.text: Sets the level of SYNC3XL's oscillator I output, from silence at fully counter-clockwise to unmodified at fully clockwise
Sets the level of SYNC3XL's oscillator II output, from silence at fully counter-clockwise to unmodified at fully clockwise
Sets the level of SYNC3XL's oscillator III output, from silence at fully counter-clockwise to unmodified at fully clockwise
Sets the level of SYNC3XL's mix output, from silence at fully counter-clockwise to unmodified at fully clockwise

inputs.text: Adds to the oscillator I level knob at a volt per fifth of the knob's travel; the sum is clamped to 0V-10V, so 10V doubles what the knob alone would pass
Adds to the oscillator II level knob at a volt per fifth of the knob's travel; the sum is clamped to 0V-10V, so 10V doubles what the knob alone would pass
Adds to the oscillator III level knob at a volt per fifth of the knob's travel; the sum is clamped to 0V-10V, so 10V doubles what the knob alone would pass
Adds to the mix level knob at a volt per fifth of the knob's travel; the sum is clamped to 0V-10V, so 10V doubles what the knob alone would pass

notes: this module does nothing unless a SYNC3XL is placed immediately to its left. On its own it has no outputs and drives nothing.
all four knobs come up at zero. Placing this expander beside a SYNC3XL therefore silences that module's four audio outputs until a knob or a CV input raises them.
the four jacks are the only outputs this module has an effect through; the signal never passes through the panel, it is multiplied inside SYNC3XL.

inputs.0:
0 to 10V · continuous · one channel only

a negative voltage does nothing here; the knob and this input are summed and the total held to 0 to 10V.
